derivation: or מִסְמֵר; also (feminine) מַסְמְרָה; or מִסְמְרָה; or even מַשְׂמְרָה; (Ecclesiastes 12:11), from H5568 (סָמַר);
def: a peg (as bristling from the surface)

occurrences.text: And David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates, and for the joinings; and brass in abundance without weight;
And the weight of the nails was fifty shekels of gold. And he overlaid the upper chambers with gold.

So the carpenter encouraged the goldsmith, and he that smootheth with the hammer him that smote the anvil, saying, It is ready for the sodering: and he fastened it with nails, that it should not be moved.
They deck it with silver and with gold; they fasten it with nails and with hammers, that it move not.
